title: Knowledge
summary: The root of the owner's private, progressively discoverable knowledge base.

about.title: About
about.summary: Knowledge whose subject is the owner: their introduction, timeline, themes, practices, and interests.

automations.title: Automations
automations.summary: Instructions and supporting assets used by automations running in external harnesses.

automations/activity-distiller.title: Activity distiller
automations/activity-distiller.summary: Canonical instructions and minimal checkpoint state for reconciling connected activity into maintained knowledge.

companies.title: Companies
companies.summary: Companies the owner works with, is considering, competes with, or follows, described factually and with dates.

events.title: Events
events.summary: Conferences, trips, dinners, hackathons, and other happenings the owner took part in, grouped by date.

library.title: Library
library.summary: External works saved for recall, with their useful ideas, the owner's reaction, and connections to existing knowledge.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.summary: Meetings and calls worth remembering, recording who was there, what was said, and what came of them.

objects.title: Objects
objects.summary: Individually meaningful physical things whose identity or history matters over time.

people.title: People
people.summary: People in the owner's life and work: who they are, how the owner knows them, and what they are doing now.

places.title: Places
places.summary: Locations that matter because the owner returns to them, makes decisions about them, or connects them to several parts of the knowledge base.

skills.title: Skills
skills.summary: Reusable Agent Skills stored as versioned SKILL.md pages.

about/diary.title: Diary
about/diary.summary: The owner's chronological record of lived context, actions, decisions, and current state.

about/projects.title: Projects
about/projects.summary: Enduring bodies of work the owner builds, operates, or stewards, with concise canonical context and curated milestones.

about/tasks.title: Tasks
about/tasks.summary: Durable frames for finite outcomes, decisions, and experiments the owner is pursuing or considering.
